title: Forklift daily inspection log, a record with missing days

must.line: subject includes something like "powered industrial trucks" or "forklift" or "worker safety"
doc_date: September 2026, kind "last entry" with the date September 19, 2026
Status (must): recorded, with last entry September 19, 2026. Never "compliant". Not gaps_found as a program-style status.
1. No entries for September 3 and 4 while the hour meter shows the truck ran between September 2 and September 5. Citation contains "1910.178(q)(7)".
2. September 9 records the horn as defective with no note that the truck was removed from service or repaired. Citation contains "1910.178(q)(7)" or "1910.178(p)(1)".
3. The last entry is September 19; if the run date is later than September 22, the scan notes that the log has no entries since and asks whether the truck is still in service or a later page exists.
must.note: Widened after the first judging pass: the spec's concept is "the last entry is September 19 and is anything newer coming", and run 3 said exactly that in the model's own words — "The most recent entry is 6 days old; confirm this log has entries through today if the truck continues in service" — while matching only one of the original keywords. The concept is unchanged; the phrasings are the model's rather than the spec's.
